prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind them, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a gentle soft smile, sleek silver-grey hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a tin square-sided cowbell, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver hair ornaments. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a brown leather cowboy hat, a red bandana knotted at his neck, a silver sheriff star pinned on a thin leather chest strap, and a minimal brown leather with mirror-polished metallic silver studs T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult German man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, fair skin with a neutral undertone, a playful half-grin, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a tin hammer head, a silver round bell, a gold square-sided cowbell, a tin small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single platinum necklace. RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal mirror-polished metallic white satin with mirror-polished metallic gold trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
